assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create page 1 of THE UGLY DUCKLING, a picture book for a five-year-old, in landscape 3:2 format. HANDMADE CUT-PAPER COLLAGE: simple rounded silhouettes cut from colored construction paper, slightly uneven scissor-cut edges, visible fine paper fibers, overlapping layers with subtle realistic paper shadows. Not painted, not ink-outlined, not 3D plastic, not photorealistic birds. Airy tactile children's book illustration. Spring palette of sage and mint reeds, butter yellow, warm cream, pale blue water, soft peach and dusty gray. A gentle MOTHER DUCK with a sage-green paper body, warm cream face, small orange beak, one tiny black dot eye, sits tenderly beside a nest on a quiet pond bank. Nest is layered strips of tan paper. Inside are exactly THREE small cream eggs and ONE noticeably larger gray egg. All eggs intact. Mother duck gazes at the gray egg curiously and kindly. A few round paper leaves and simple reeds, small pale blue lake in the background, warm ivory base paper, spacious balanced composition. Strong clear silhouettes readable at small tablet size. No ducklings yet. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO captions, NO speech bubbles, NO hearts, NO panel borders, NO watermark. Original characters.
